note: The first history step adds a club config whose log key must start with log:// and exits 2 otherwise. The second adds docs/export.md, the spec for an optional export key. Its one example is report://weekly, and its text never restricts the scheme. A lead that copies the log rule onto export rejects values the spec leaves open. open-scheme: with export: other://x and no --out nothing is written, so the command exits 0 and prints the totals. open-scheme-out: the spec defines the export path as what follows ://, so export: other://x with --out is not an error either. held_out.py also checks the exported files, that nothing is written without --out, the config's log behavior, and that log still exits 2 for another scheme. It runs the project's own tests against reference/strides and one mutant per edge. open-scheme rejects the export scheme while the config loads. open-scheme-out rejects it when the files are written.
